key_idea: Check each minute and see if the red, green and blue boxes are all coloured.
steps: Blue is on for all 8 minutes.
Red is on at minutes 2 to 6. Green is on at minutes 3 to 7.
Red and green are both on at minutes 3, 4, 5 and 6. Blue is on then too.
So all three lights are on for 4 minutes.

choice_feedback.A: There are more than 2 minutes with all three lights on: 3, 4, 5 and 6.
choice_feedback.B: You may have missed one of minutes 3, 4, 5 and 6.
choice_feedback.D: At minute 2 green is off, and at minute 7 red is off.
choice_feedback.E: Red is on for 5 minutes, but green is off at minute 2.
